<b>Red Memory</b> is an [[Areas (Silksong)|area]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i> visited as part of the [[Act 3]] plotline. In it, [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] journeys through her own memories to find the [[Everbloom]].

== Description ==
[[File: Screenshot SS Red Memory 03.png|thumb|left|200px|Path to Weavers' Den]]
Red Memory is [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]]'s memory of her past and her upbringing. It is a foggy, dream-like area with several strands of thread strung across the whole area over a faint spider's web, with a deep red colour behind it all. Like with [[Silk Heart]] memories, a loud heartbeat along with whispers can be heard throughout most of the area. Paths laid with thread, and orbs of Silk that can be used to [[Needle-bounce]] off, lead up to the entrance to Hornet's memory within [[Weavers' Den]]. After Weavers' Den, Hornet's memory leads to the settlement of [[Distant Village]], suspended structures of webs made from red threads laid with banners bearing the eyes of a [[Weaver]]. Here, one of the cocoons leads to [[Beast's Den]] and contains a memory of Hornet and [[Herrah the Beast|her mother]] in a throne room. 

Following Hornet's memory of her mother and a hallway lined with Weaver insignias, the area transitions into [[the Hive]] and its hexagonal architecture and furniture. Bright, orange light covers most of this section, with the walls and floor formed out of hardened honey in hexagonal shapes and occasionally, a [[Hiveling]] can be seen flying across. Faint webs can be seen layered over the Hive's architecture with clumps of honey over gaps that can be used to platform across, leading to a gateway that contains a memory of Hornet training with [[Hive Queen Vespa]].

Past the Hive, Hornet enters her memory of the [[White Palace]]. It is characterised by a bright, pale light and its ornate architecture bearing the design of [[the Pale King]]'s crown, decorated by grey flora. At the edges of the White Palace, glowing, pale roots can be seen. Like the previous two sections, the White Palace is covered in a layer of thread. For this section, [[Wingmould (Silksong)|Wingmoulds]] floating across gaps are used to traverse the White Palace. At its end, Hornet descends to a memory of [[the White Lady]], during the descent, the heartbeats and whispers can no longer be heard.

While Hornet can be harmed by the spikes on top of the Distant Village lift, platforms in the White Palace section, and contact with [[Wingmould]]s, she is unable to die from this damage. Falling during any of the platforming sections returns her to the last safe ground unharmed.

== How to Access ==
After acquiring three out of the four possible [[Old Hearts|old hearts]] for the <i>[[SEEK: The Old Hearts]]</i> objective, Hornet can visit the [[Snail Shamans (Silksong)|Snail Shamans]] in the [[Ruined Chapel]] and hand the hearts to them. Upon doing so, the Snail Shamans use the three hearts on Hornet to put her into Red Memory. If all four hearts have been obtained, Conjoined Heart remains unused.

Red Memory becomes inaccessible after the final memory takes place and Hornet receives the [[Everbloom]].
